Senses.Explanation: 瓦解冰消 means collapse and melt away. Yuanwu Keqin says Huanglong Huinan's unresolved point dissolved when he investigated Xuansha's words; Miyun Yuanwu says doubts disappear on arriving and seeing directly. Zhongfeng Mingben applies the image to the collapse of inherited patriarchal forms. Yunmen Wenyan uses the terse phrase directly upon a monk's entrance, leaving its target to the encounter.
Senses.Note: The compound is a single image of thorough dissolution, not two separate techniques or stages. Context supplies what collapses. Three Yunmen witnesses preserve one parallel encounter family and must not be counted as three independent semantic deployments.
